## Net Lease Office Properties Declares Special Cash Distribution of $1.50 Per Share


11/04/2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 153 KB](https://s202.q4cdn.com/332621640/files/doc_news/Net-Lease-Office-Properties-Declares-Special-Cash-Distribution-of-1-50-Per-Share-2026.pdf)


*Announces Sales of Three Office Properties for $34 Million*


NEW YORK


, Nov. 4, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Net Lease Office Properties (NYSE: NLOP) reported today that its Board of Trustees declared a special cash distribution of $1.50 per common share, totaling approximately $22 million. The distribution is payable on December 1, 2026 to shareholders of record as of the close of business on November 16, 2026. Including this distribution, NLOP has declared distributions totaling $24.19 per share since being spun off in November 2023.


The following properties were recently sold for gross proceeds totaling approximately $34.4 million.

**Net Lease Office Properties**
